title: Excluding the second and third cases of a three-case enum leaves only its first case, so a return contract restricted to that case is sound.

ground_truth.statement: Excluding the second and third cases of a three-case enum leaves only its first case, so a return contract restricted to that case is sound.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
